help_text:
Usage: kasumi <command> [options]

Commands:
  kasumi config                                Interactive profile wizard.
  kasumi sync <profile>                        Synchronize with remote storage.
  kasumi sync <profile> --dry-run              Simulate without altering data.
  kasumi status <profile>                      Show pending local changes.
  kasumi fsck <profile>                        Audit remote integrity.
  kasumi gc <profile>                          Remove orphaned objects.

Remote inspection (read-only):
  kasumi remote heads <profile>                Current logical heads.
  kasumi remote tree <profile> [--head <id>]   Tree of a specific head.
  kasumi remote commits <profile>              Reachable commits.
  kasumi remote summary <profile>              General vault summary.
  kasumi remote stat <profile> <path>          Properties of a specific path.
  kasumi remote commit <profile> <id>          Commit details.
  kasumi remote get <profile> <path> <dst>     Download authenticated file.
  kasumi remote epochs <profile>               Epoch chain.
  kasumi remote epoch <profile> <id>           Epoch details.
  kasumi remote contents <profile>             Contents by metadata.
  kasumi remote contents --audit <profile>     Cryptographic audit.
  kasumi remote content <profile> <id>         Content details.
  kasumi remote markers <profile>              Classify physical markers.
  kasumi remote objects <profile>              Physical namespace.
  kasumi remote orphans <profile>              List orphans; does not run GC.
  kasumi remote quarantine <profile>           Quarantine state.
  kasumi remote writers <profile>              Writers and barrier.
  kasumi remote health <profile>               Full remote health diagnostic.

General options:
  -h, --help, help                             Show this help message.
  -v, --version, version                       Show Kasumi version.
  --lang <en|pt-BR>                            Set language (English default).
